decisions.reason: The modular waste processing concept draws on the firm's core environmental-technology know-how and has a documented customer saving of over 600,000 euros a year, so management can interpret its results and keep refining it, though it may be folded into the flagship modular line C.
As the multi-model flagship that embodies the firm's modular direction, it builds directly on accumulated knowledge and R&D cooperation, so management will keep investing in it.
The mobile trommel screen sits close to the core offer and fits the existing service and telematics network, which makes its field results easy to read and learn from at low risk.

The new multi-model slow-speed shredder line, with its own web page, appears to have absorbed the learning from withdrawn Product B and builds squarely on core shredding know-how, so it is the firm's chosen platform to develop further.

The spiral shaft screen line extends the firm's screening expertise into adjacent technology with several models, and its own R&D lets it assimilate early feedback and improve the product rather than drop it.
